core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Personal Care; Health and Beauty; Logistics and Supply Chain Management
specialty_focus: Nadro is a leading Mexican wholesale distributor specializing in the logistics, storage, and supply-chain management of pharmaceutical, personal care, health, and beauty products. It serves as a core link between manufacturers and pharmacies across Mexico, distributing medical drugs, personal care lines, and hygiene goods from approximately 450 principal manufacturing laboratories and global consumer brands to pharmacies and hospitals. Nadro does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Pfizer, Bayer, Roche, Unilever, Nestlé, Colgate, others
